stories.headline: Indian Navy frees a hijacked Iranian fishing boat off Somalia
body: Indian naval forces freed the Iranian boat Azini and its 20 crew after a 48-hour-plus operation.
It took place in the Arabian Sea, over 3,000 km from Mumbai.
Indian forces disarmed 12 suspected Somali pirates and released them, a Puntland official said.
stories.vc: Safer shipping lanes lower insurance costs for India's trade routes.

stories.headline: Israel's opposition backs Eisenkot to replace Netanyahu
body: Israel's main opposition leaders agreed to back Gadi Eisenkot as prime minister.
President Herzog starts talks with parties on Wednesday about who forms a government.
The bloc is still split on whether to ally with Arab-led parties.
stories.joke: One candidate, many partners, zero easy maths.
stories.vc: A long coalition fight delays Israel's budget and key policy calls.

stories.headline: Death toll from Russian strike on Ukraine aid site rises to 29
body: The toll from the Russian attack on an aid site in Komyshuvakha, Zaporizhzhia, rose to 29, with 48 missing.
Overnight strikes also hit power plants and damaged hospitals across Ukraine.
Rescuers are still searching the rubble.
stories.vc: Strikes on power plants before winter raise Ukraine's energy import needs and rebuilding costs.

stories.headline: Syria says it foiled a plot against the Homs oil refinery
body: Syria's intelligence service said it arrested a cell it links to Hezbollah planning to target the Homs refinery.
Explosive devices were seized.
Hezbollah denied the claims, saying it has no presence in Syria.
stories.vc: Threats to energy sites keep regional risk premiums on oil high.

stories.headline: Jewellery brand GIVA raises ₹975 crore, plans 160 new stores
body: GIVA raised ₹975 crore led by Multiples, with Epiq Capital and Edelweiss joining.
It plans 160 new stores this year and wants 75–80% of revenue offline within three years.
FY26 revenue rose to ₹865 crore from ₹505 crore.
stories.joke: Online brand discovers that people still like trying on rings.
stories.vc: D2C brands going offline at scale shows stores are back as a growth engine, not a legacy cost.

stories.headline: Indian startups launch homegrown AI models under IndiaAI Mission
body: Soket Labs launched EKA-1, a 26.3 billion parameter model trained on about 7.5 trillion tokens.
It supports 22 Indian languages and English; ZenteiQ released open-source Dhīr 2B and 5B models.
Both got subsidised compute through the IndiaAI Mission.
stories.vc: Government-backed compute is helping Indian labs build local models; adoption will decide the payoff.

stories.headline: Azim Premji Foundation launches a social startups programme
body: The Azim Premji Foundation will help development professionals start and run civil society organisations.
The first cohort of about 100 covers Odisha, the North-East, eastern UP and Bengaluru Urban.
Focus areas include livelihoods, health, mental health, disability and children.
stories.joke: Startups for good, minus the pitch-deck jargon.
stories.vc: Grant-backed social ventures fill gaps markets ignore, a model impact investors watch.

stories.headline: Ferrari's mocked Luce EV is sold out for 2027
body: Ferrari's first EV, the Jony Ive-designed Luce, is fully allocated for 2027, CEO Benedetto Vigna said.
It was widely panned when it debuted in May, sending Ferrari's stock lower.
Buyers now face a one-year wait.
stories.joke: Everyone hated it. Everyone also bought it.
stories.vc: Luxury EV demand holding up shows brand power can override design criticism.

stories.headline: Apple restricts dating apps and AI companions to adults
body: Apple will require dating apps and AI companions with romantic content to carry an 18+ rating.
The new rules start on 16 November.
It follows Apple's global age-checking rollout and new parental controls.
stories.vc: Age rules shrink teen markets for AI companion apps and raise compliance costs.
